testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a staged command on the View ribbon target: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:968:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a staged command on the View ribbon target ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the View ribbon tab is selected ✔ And the Part | View custom target is empty ✔ When the user opens Customize User Commands from the Windows panel context menu ✔ And the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in All Commands ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the Part | View target ✔ And the target is marked as changed ✔ When the user cancels customization ✔ And the user reopens Customize User Commands from the Windows panel context menu ✔ Then the Part | View target is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in All Commands ✔ When the user closes customization ✔ Then the View ribbon remains visible
